description.value: If a player wants to play without an Innate Technique and does not wish to use New Shadow Style or Divergent Fist, they can instead gain a +2 Ability Score Increase AND Feat they meet the prerequisites for at 1st and 3rd level. A +3 ASI and Feat at 6th level and 11th, and +3 ASI and 2 Feats at 18th level. Do be warned, this will of course be generally weaker than having a technique.

jjk5e.automationNotes: On each 1st/3rd/6th/11th/18th level the module asks for the ASI points and the feat(s).
